AdmissionConfig.description: `verify.yaml`'s `admission:` block: the bound on heavy commands launched at once.

capacity.description: Weight units that may be held at once. Absent means half the physical cores, at least one.

enabled.description: Off means every heavy command is admitted at once.

full_suite_weight.description: The weight of an unfiltered full test suite.

grant_ttl_seconds.description: A grant nobody released is reclaimed after this long.

heavy_weight.description: The weight of an ordinary heavy command (build, check, a filtered test).

max_wait_seconds.description: How long a waiting command is held before it is let through without a grant.

admission.description: The admission book bounding how many heavy commands runs launch at once.

aging_seconds.description: A queued request that has waited this long moves up one priority level.

broker_prefix.description: The argv prefixed to every unit when it runs (a machine's broker). Empty means none.

cache_days.description: Days a green unit stays reusable by the cache (spec §5.3).

capacity.description: Weight units that may run at once across the whole machine.

disk_cap_gb.description: The ceiling, in GB, on the whole machine's warm state.

unit_timeout_seconds.description: The wall clock one unit may take before it is killed.
